articles.summary: Healthcare Providers, Healthcare Settings, and Participating Pharmacies Can Now Begin Required Training and Certification in Preparation for MIUDELLA’s Launch Later This Year Organon (NYSE: OGN), a global healthcare company with a mission to deliver impactful medicines and solutions for a healthier every day, today announced the MIUDELLA ® (copper intrauterine system) Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Program is now open for enrollment at www.miudellarems.com . The website enables healthcare providers, healthcare settings, and eligible specialty pharmacies to complete the certification and enrollment activities required to support the dispensing and insertion of MIUDELLA. MIUDELLA is a hormone-free, copper intrauterine device (IUD) indicated for the prevention of pregnancy in females of reproductive potential for up to 3 years. articles.summary: All healthcare providers who dispense NEXPLANON® (etonogestrel implant) 68 mg are required to complete NEXPLANON REMS certification by August 23, 2026 to maintain access to NEXPLANON. All providers who administer NEXPLANON must become REMS certified, including those who previously completed the Clinical Training Program (CTP). The goal of the NEXPLANON REMS is to mitigate complications due to improper insertion and removal. Certification requirements vary by provider status: Active inserters: Complete certification online at www.NEXPLANONREMS.com by reviewing the Prescribing Information and Healthcare Provider Guide and submitting the Knowledge Assessment and Enrollment Form. Inactive or new providers: Complete all required training, including online didactic and in-person practical training.
